es: Reconocer y usar frases para pedir, mantener y ceder la palabra, interrumpir con tacto y resumir en una reunión.

teaching.en: Could I have the floor for a minute? I have a point about the park.
teaching.es: ¿Podría tener la palabra un minuto? Tengo una idea sobre el parque.
teaching.explanationEs: Could I have the floor? = pedir la palabra con tacto.
segments: Could I have the floor for a minute?
I have a point about the park.
teaching.audioText: Could I have the floor for a minute? I have a point about the park.

teaching.en: Sorry to interrupt, but the meeting ends at nine.
teaching.es: Perdona que te interrumpa, pero la reunión termina a las nueve.
teaching.explanationEs: Sorry to interrupt, but… = interrumpir con tacto.
segments: Sorry to interrupt, but the

teaching.audioText: Sorry to interrupt, but the meeting ends at nine.

teaching.en: Let me finish my point, and then you can add your idea.

segments: Let me finish my point, and

teaching.en: Thank you, Tom. I'll hand over to Sara, our chair.

teaching.en: Go ahead, Leo. The floor is yours: over to you.

segments: Go ahead, Leo. The floor

teaching.en: To sum up, we agree on three things, so let me add the dates.

teaching.explanationEs: To sum up = resumir; introduce el resumen final.
segments: To sum up, we agree on three
things, so let me add the dates.
teaching.audioText: To sum up, we agree on three things, so let me add the dates.

title.en: Due to, set to, about to

teaching.en: The new library is due to open in March.
